name: Form Depricarping (Web)
implementation_notes: REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, correcting the original design the user explicitly rejected): the Depricarping Detail grid is now DYNAMIC -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() now exist on FormDepricarping.php, exactly mirroring FormPressing's just-fixed Pressing Detail grid (screen-058)/FormThreshing's Threshing Detail grid (screen-057) and FormCagesTrack's Cages Tipped Time grid. Grid starts empty on create mode (was: built from DepricarpingRecordService::canonicalTimeSlots() into 24 rows on mount); edit mode still loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 8 reading-column inputs per row are genuinely editable number/text fields, never disabled -- Depricarping has no computed detail-grid fields (for comparison, Form Cages Track Web's Total Cages/Cages Remain, formerly disabled inputs, have been rendered as plain text since 2026-10-04), so the 'no disabled web inputs' rule applies with zero exceptions in this screen (enforced statically by tests/Feature/Livewire/WebFormNoDisabledFieldTest.php); Downtime (Mins) is a plain number input and Findings a plain text input, both freely editable like the other 6 numeric columns -- a row simply counts as filled when EITHER is set, same as any other reading column

Target Operasional table queried directly by FormDepricarping::render(), never sent as part of the create/update payload; renders 4 columns (one more than Threshing/Pressing's 3) matching the entity-catalog's own shape for this station -- UNTOUCHED by this revision
Route /data/depricarping/create registered BEFORE /data/depricarping/{id} (screen-055) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormPressing's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By, unlike Form Weighbridge/Grading Web which only have Acknowledged)

Ran the full backend Pest suite as the final step of this 6-screen pass: 1287/1287 passing (up from the pre-fix baseline of 1275/1275), confirming zero regressions across Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping and every other station

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): DepricarpingRecordService::create() memanggil assertPeriodOpenForWrite('depricarping', station->business_unit_id, date) setelah validasi & resolve station dan sebelum penulisan pertama; update() memanggilnya dua kali (tanggal lama record dan tanggal baru dari body) setelah findOrFail/cek akses/validasi — jadi memindahkan record keluar dari periode tertutup juga ditolak. Penolakan = PeriodClosedException 422 PERIOD_CLOSED dengan salah satu dari 4 pesan (belum ada periode / masih Draft / sudah ditutup / di luar rentang + rentang yang berlaku), nol baris tersimpan. FormDepricarping::save() menangkap HttpException dan menampilkan pesannya sebagai alert halaman ($generalError). Test yang menutupnya: tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan + cek statis ke-18 service) dan tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php (end-to-end via Sterilizer); test per-layar (tests/Unit/Services/DepricarpingRecordServiceTest.php, tests/Feature/Api/FormDepricarpingTest.php, tests/Feature/Livewire/FormDepricarpingTest.php) membuka periode Terbuka sebagai prasyarat via openPeriodFor()/openPeriodForStation(). test_results tidak diubah (suite tidak dijalankan ulang untuk sinkronisasi ini).

REVISI v4 (2026-10-03, uji ditambahkan — kode produksi tidak diubah): tests/Feature/Api/FormDepricarpingTest.php kini punya 3 uji HTTP kunci periode per-stasiun yang menutup celah 'penolakan kunci periode hanya diuji end-to-end via Sterilizer': (1) 'kunci periode: menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED saat POST bertanggal di periode tertutup, tanpa menyimpan satu baris pun'; (2) 'kunci periode: menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED saat PATCH record yang tanggal lamanya di periode tertutup walau tanggal barunya di periode terbuka, dan record tidak berubah'; (3) 'kunci periode: menerima 201 saat POST tepat pada tanggal awal dan tanggal akhir periode terbuka (inklusif)'. Ketiganya mengganti periode prasyarat dengan sepasang periode tertutup + terbuka lewat helper replacePrerequisiteWithClosedAndOpenPeriods() di tests/Pest.php. Berkas kini 21 uji, semuanya hijau (test_results.integration diperbarui).
